Singer's Vehicle Fired Upon, Gang Claims Responsibility

A Range Rover parked outside the home of Haryanvi singer Diler Kharkiya was fired upon. Four gangsters claimed responsibility for the incident in a social media post. In a separate but related incident, singer Sudesh was allegedly threatened by individuals claiming to be from the Lawrence gang, demanding ₹2 lakh and warning of gunfire within two days. Sudesh has sought security from the Kaithal SP. The Punjab Kesari outlet reported that the singer narrowly escaped harm during the firing incident.
